question: Through which of the following states does the National Waterway-96 pass?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• National Waterway-96 pass from** Jharkhand, West Bengal & Odisha.**
 
• It is located on the **Subaranekha river.**
 
• The length of the waterway is **314 Km.**
